facts.anchor: I actively tried not to hate Joel. He was the father of my children; they wouldn’t exist without him. As much as I wanted to blame him entirely for our divorce, I couldn’t. Yes, he cheated.

facts.anchor: So no, I didn’t hate him—I hated his selfish streak.
